content_blocks.text: The PLA are delighted to announce the winners of the 2016-17 Essay Prize competition. The 2016-17 competition was on the theme of “Brexit”. We received some excellent entries, and the winners are as follows:
heading_path: The Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2016 – 2017 – Winners

content_blocks.text: 1 – James Frampton, pupil Barrister at Keating Chambers
heading_path: The Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2016 – 2017 – Winners

content_blocks.text: 2 – Barbara Bell, unregistered Barrister, seeking pupillages (currently at UBS)
heading_path: The Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2016 – 2017 – Winners

content_blocks.text: 3 – Amy Rose Warman, trainee solicitor at Shakespeare Martineau LLP.
heading_path: The Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2016 – 2017 – Winners

content_blocks.text: The presentation to the winners will take place at the PLA’s Annual General Meeting to be held in early 2018 (details to be announced).
heading_path: The Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2016 – 2017 – Winners

content_blocks.text: For details of how to enter the 2017-18 competition, please see here .
